proposed_action: Update agent_loop.py to automatically generate new candidates when the candidates file is empty or all candidates have status implemented or archived
rationale: This removes the manual bootstrap step and makes the system more self-sustaining while keeping human oversight for final approval.
evidence: Current loop requires manual creation of agent_candidates.json. The first run needed a special bootstrap file. Automating proposal generation when exhausted would create a true persistent idea pipeline.
risk_notes: Risk of low-quality auto-generated candidates; mitigated by strict validation gate and human review before implementation.

proposed_action: Add a quality scoring system inside candidate_validator.py and reject candidates below a configured threshold
rationale: Raises the overall standard of candidates flowing into the ledger and forces better reasoning from all source models.
evidence: Current validation only checks minimum length and presence. Many marginal candidates can still pass. A composite score based on clarity, evidence strength, and risk coverage would improve signal quality.
risk_notes: Might be too strict initially and reject good but terse ideas. Can be tuned after collecting data.

proposed_action: Create a new script ledger_analytics.py that generates summary reports from idea_ledger.jsonl
rationale: Turns the growing ledger from raw log into actionable intelligence for improving the agent system over time.
evidence: We already append rich validation and correction data. Without analysis tools, repeated weak rationales and failure patterns stay hidden.
risk_notes: Low risk. Purely read-only analytics script.
